evidence_kind: Matching PE/PDB and retained static disassembly; no original-engine runtime observation

native_domain.spawn: ScriptAction.SpawnObstacle18026f7dc obtains singleton ObstacleManager.Instance180062f80;26f801 calls its Create1802c7ad0. Create allocates from that manager+38 EntityManager. UseScreenLocation is applied only after creation by virtual action0x4f.
native_domain.consequence: Screen-rendered script obstacles, their Thing primaries and InitData-created graphs remain native world-domain animations. A portable Screen resource backend does not imply native GameUI ownership or an unscaled GUI clock.
native_domain.generic_create: ScriptAction.CreateAnimation18026222b resolves World.GetActiveThing;26226e loads MANAGERS[0] directly,262297 calls Create. Table and standalone branches also select MANAGERS[0].
native_domain.init_data_create: Animation.InitData1802932f5 passes the current animation entity+44 to GetManager18029e7b0; subsequent Create calls use that animation's actual manager. GetManager resolves entity domain via >>30 and the AnimHandle component.
native_domain.setup_screen_flag: ScriptAction.SetupAnimation180262da0..262dc2 sets the animation own screen flag when destination Thing+220 is true OR args.UseScreenLocation is true, then propagates SetUseScreenLocation along the child chain. This is separate from DrawScreenRelative action0x4f, which changes only the Thing render flag. Native InitData-created graphs do not invoke ScriptAction.SetupAnimation.

owner_state.location: Thing.GetLocation1802e0b70 reads raw XY+88 when no actual attached parent; source screen spawn currently rejects Attach.
owner_state.body: Use actual retained Body scale times its scale fraction, actual angle, per-axis transition fractions, base packed color and source-initialized HSV (Thing.InitThing1802dd5c0). No actor or Physics component is manufactured.
owner_state.bounds: A source screen definition that needs Physics (InitPhysics1802dda20 Grip<99999) or nonzero StartAngle stays rejected until those screen consumers are reconstructed.
owner_state.fraction_color: Body.GetColorModifier1802b55c0..2b564c clamps each RGB/alpha fraction to[0,1], multiplies255 and truncates via CVTTSS2SI. Base color bytes are separate.
owner_state.lifetime: Marking a screen Thing dead does not clear its Body/entity immediately. OnAttachedToPreDispose18029a2f0 needs the final owner state before the manager clears that lifetime. Native DieWithOwner/detach policy remains owned by ActionEffectWorld.

clocks_and_live_fields.elapsed: World.Update314fdf scales manager elapsed once. TimeModifierSystem188cde..188d07 reads global World+20;188e02..188ebb divides the manager elapsed by speed+(1-speed)*animationFraction.188ff0..189061 applies Thing+80 only for a real AttachedToTimeMultiplier link. Thing.TimeModifierFraction is not the animation's fraction.
clocks_and_live_fields.multiplier_default: Thing.Defaults1802dbe6a writes1 to live Thing+80. ReflectionHelper.Thing1802e6fe2 exposes ElapsedTimeMultiplier as that live member independently of resource backend.
clocks_and_live_fields.mutation: The portable screen Thing retains live ElapsedTimeMultiplier and SuppressSounds; existing primitive reflection applies actual requested mutations instead of silently skipping screen targets.
clocks_and_live_fields.prefer_unmodified: ScriptAction.CreateAnimation calls SetupAnimation262c50, which calls PreferUnmodifiedTime29a5c0 unconditionally. That method applies only where source TimeModifierFraction<0 and iterates self then mChild+0xc8 at29a734. It does not traverse independent CreateAnimation/CreateAnimations roots. ScriptAction.SetAnimation261a10 has its own argument handling and does not call SetupAnimation or PreferUnmodifiedTime.
clocks_and_live_fields.move: ObstacleManager.Update1802c87ba/ca supplies World-scaled manager elapsed to each move helper. Move action TimeModifierFraction defaults1; UpdateTransitionHelper2c6760 conditionally divides elapsed by speed+(1-speed)*helperFraction only when fraction<1, then divides by helper UndoMultiplier. A selected helper with defaultfraction1/undo1 consumes World-scaled elapsed. Fraction0 cancels world speed only when actually requested.
clocks_and_live_fields.body_transition: Screen bodies remain world Body consumers. BodyTransition.advance(worldElapsed,worldSpeed) follows the same existing recovered Body helper equation as actual actor bodies; helper remaining counts elapsed/worldSpeed independently of the animation or Move helper fraction.

audio.eligibility: Reuse actual AudioManager owner admission: live SuppressSounds, source HighPrioritySfx, actual voice classification, allocated-channel cap and frame counter. Screen owners must preserve the same eligibility rules.
audio.adaptation: Android screen audio currently uses explicitly non-spatial output while retaining original cue graph/admission/fade semantics. Native Camera screen-to-world 3D source conversion is not claimed.

verification_boundary: Requires original-script host progression and actual presentation/lifetime checks after graph integration. Static evidence and source implementation alone do not prove physical-device interaction, native GPU parity or Android lifecycle behavior.
